purpose: Protocol-only, platform-generic construction contract for immutable Modeling Batches. This reference contains no domain model, scenario target, or acceptance answer.

session_id.description: MCP tool argument; identifies the Build Session.

expected_workspace_version.invariant: Required in every mode and must equal the current workspace version at Service submission.

depends_on.invariant: Every entry must name a client_item_id in THIS SAME batch: the platform resolves dependencies against the current batch's items only, so naming an item from an earlier batch yields a blocking invalid_dependency finding. Cross-batch ordering is guaranteed by submitting batches sequentially in dependency order and is never expressed in the payload

competency_question_ids.invariant: Keep empty (the default) unless the platform project actually contains those CompetencyQuestion rows: R3.0-011 question pools are run artifacts only and are never registered as platform resources, so syncing pool IDs here yields blocking competency_question_not_found findings and the batch fails closed

class_id.server_behavior: accepted then replaced by the deterministic Modeling Item output ID

name.server_current_acceptance: compiler does not prevalidate scalar type and literalizes accepted values; Protocol MUST send a string

semantic_definition.description: R4.0-002 common declaration; see platform-neutral-candidate-authoring.json multiview_semantic_definition.

property_id.server_behavior: accepted then replaced by the deterministic Modeling Item output ID

class_id.server_current_acceptance: approved domain Class is optional (R3.0-009 §4.3); compiler does not prevalidate scalar type; Protocol MUST send a string

name.server_current_acceptance: compiler does not prevalidate scalar type and literalizes accepted values; Protocol MUST send a string

datatype.branch: DatatypeProperty; a datatype property MUST carry its real datatype

object_class_id.branch: ObjectProperty Class range; optional. datatype and object_class_id are mutually exclusive; when both are supplied the payload is rejected

semantic_definition.description: R4.0-002 common declaration; see platform-neutral-candidate-authoring.json multiview_semantic_definition.

relation_type_id.server_behavior: accepted then replaced by the deterministic Modeling Item output ID

semantic_definition.description: R4.0-002 common declaration; see platform-neutral-candidate-authoring.json multiview_semantic_definition.

shape_id.server_behavior: accepted then replaced by the deterministic Modeling Item output ID

target_class_id.branch: Legacy class target; resolved to sh:targetClass.

target_node_iri.branch: sh:targetNode; caller-supplied absolute IRI, the platform never guesses an IRI from a name.

entity_id.server_behavior: accepted then replaced by the deterministic Modeling Item output ID

class_iri_or_legacy_id.branch: Legacy scalar Class; when class_iris is also supplied the expanded scalar MUST be a member of it, otherwise the payload is a class_membership_conflict.

class_iris.description: Full formal Class set (R3.0-009 §4.1/§6.2). Entries are class ids or absolute IRIs, deduplicated by the compiler. Omitted, null and [] are the same legal zero-member state; no placeholder Class is invented.

properties.description: Property keys are non-empty strings; lists are rejected by the handler.

semantic_definition.description: R4.0-002 common declaration; see platform-neutral-candidate-authoring.json multiview_semantic_definition.

action_definition.description: R4.0-003 input/output status on an ordinary Action; see reusable_action_semantics.

parameter_definition.description: R4.0-003 structured parameter metadata on its own stable entity; references remain graph relations.

rule_definition.description: R4.0-005 stored business rule declaration; see business_rule_semantics. No script execution.

create_operation.invariant: Operation v1 validation remains unchanged; active Operations require a nonempty tool binding. No secrets or Action annotations. Association nodes link to this resource, never merge identities.

cross_batch_application_contract.purpose: Platform-generic, create-only topological schedule for applying one immutable semantic candidate across Modeling Batches. It adds no business semantics and does not change candidate meaning.
cross_batch_application_contract.ordered_schedule: class -> property/relation type -> entity -> receipt/read bind generated IDs/IRIs -> relation -> only dependency-safe Shape

formal_binding.workspace_version: For every next Batch, use the current workspace version only from the immediately prior formal apply receipt or required platform read.
formal_binding.generated_identifiers: Before the relation stage, bind generated resource IDs and absolute resource IRIs only from formal create receipts or required platform reads; never guess, synthesize, or forward-reference them.

object_property_shape_relation_binding.purpose: Platform-mechanical binding for one object predicate used both by a relation and a Shape path; it adds no business semantics.
object_property_shape_relation_binding.object_predicate_rule: Any object predicate constrained by create_shape.constraints[].path_id MUST be created with create_property and object_class_id.
object_property_shape_relation_binding.relation_binding: create_relation.relation_type_iri for that predicate MUST be the formal create_property resource_iri, whose resource kind is /property/{id}.
object_property_shape_relation_binding.shape_path_resolution: The matching create_shape constraint MUST use that formal create_property resource_id as path_id; the compiler resolves it to /property/{id}.
forbidden: Do not create_relation_type for the same predicate and then use a Shape path_id that resolves to /property/{same-id}.
Do not bind create_relation.relation_type_iri to a /relation-type/{id} IRI when the matching Shape path resolves to /property/{id}.
object_property_shape_relation_binding.binding_conflict: If the candidate requires the forbidden relation-type/Shape-path combination or the required formal property receipt is absent, return a concrete translation conflict before the write.

cross_batch_application_contract.shape_activation: An applied active Shape immediately validates later Batches. Apply a Shape only after its target instances and every required property or relation path already exist.
cross_batch_application_contract.candidate_invariant: Protocol treats the Modeling candidate and its dependencies as immutable semantic input. It may schedule platform application across Batches, but must not mutate candidate meaning or reorder candidate semantics.
forbidden: delete or deactivate an applied Shape
delegate exact Batch Items to Modeling
cross_batch_application_contract.binding_conflict: If a required dependency cannot be bound from a formal receipt or platform read, return a concrete translation conflict before the dangerous write.

semantic_validation_invocation_contract.purpose: Platform-generic invocation contract for semantic validation scope selection. It contains no business semantics, scenario target, or acceptance answer.

validation_scope.other_scope_conflict: Any validation scope other than an allowed value is a concrete pre-call translation conflict; do not invoke validation.

separated_validation_and_reasoning_flow.rule: The R2.3-002 separated validation and reasoning flow explicitly invokes validation with asserted_only.

asserted_plus_reasoning.permitted_only_when: The intended validation includes the reasoning result graph and a formal reasoning receipt binds its reasoning_result_graph_iri.
asserted_plus_reasoning.reasoning_result_graph_iri: Use reasoning_result_graph_iri only when the formal reasoning receipt binds it; never guess, synthesize, or use an unbound graph IRI.
asserted_plus_reasoning.missing_graph_conflict: If asserted_plus_reasoning is intended but the formal reasoning receipt does not bind reasoning_result_graph_iri, return a concrete pre-call translation conflict; do not invoke validation.

semantic_retrieval_completion_contract.purpose: Platform-generic completion rules for ontology-scoped retrieval. It contains no business semantics or source-tracing payload.

ordinary_v3_execution.scope: Resolve the run-owned project and ontology from receipts or reads; query_semantic_context uses project_id, scope_mode=ontologies, and exact ontology_ids.
ordinary_v3_execution.question_partition: Issue one narrow query per competency question and keep resource_types narrow when the needed kind is known.
ordinary_v3_execution.recall: A degraded or unavailable vector index is incomplete; retry the same question with lexical search.
ordinary_v3_execution.pagination: Consume context_cursor before next_match_cursor. Never send both cursors or reuse a context cursor across match pages.
ordinary_v3_execution.completion: A receipt requires scope-correct, value-correct, non-truncated results and successful continuation whenever paging is required.

successful_receipt_requires: successful continuation whenever paging is required
incomplete_conditions: receipt/read count, identity, workspace, delta, or ownership drift

fallback.allowed: An incomplete or degraded generic query may use the ordinary scoped readback path before returning a typed retrieval conflict.
fallback.readback: Bind final graph, workspace and source signature, compare applied deltas with entity and statement reads, and preserve exact predicate/value and scope checks.
fallback.cursor: The stable unfiltered Session Batch inventory must have no next_cursor; statement and entity reads remain bounded and explicit.

path_id.server_current_acceptance: compiler requires presence but does not prevalidate scalar type; Protocol MUST send a string

min_count.compiler_behavior: integer coercion; numeric strings are currently accepted, but Protocol MUST send an integer

max_count.compiler_behavior: integer coercion; numeric strings are currently accepted, but Protocol MUST send an integer

update_entity.identity: entity_id or entity_iri, using the existing authorized identity binding.
update_entity.annotation_update: Annotations replace as objects, clear with null, and remain unchanged when omitted. rule_definition follows business_rule_semantics; no execution.
